It names the page, then everything marked on it: the contents heading, Last read, the bookmark's name (or "Bookmark"), the highlighted words with their colour, and notes cut short, two of each with a count of the rest. Where marks crowd closer than the 7px target (long books), up to two neighbouring marked pages follow in the same card under a divider. Notes and highlights load after the pointer rests 120ms. A press without moving is a click and goes to the mark's page.
